press_references.value: Pokémon Go 'Will Move Away From Paid Tickets' Following Years of Premium Extras — to a Greater Focus on Paid Event Passes

product_launches.description: Niantic announced changes to Pokémon Go that shift from frequent low-cost paid event tickets to higher-priced GO Pass event passes and introduce new gameplay features such as wild Shiny evolved Pokémon.

press_references.value: Pokémon Go 'New Year's 2026' event guide

product_launches.description: Niantic is running a limited-time 'New Year's 2026' in-game event in Pokémon Go from Dec. 31 to Jan. 4, featuring party hat Pokémon spawns and a special Blacephalon raid move.

press_references.value: Pokémon GO Announces ‘Precious Paths’ Season, Teases Kalos Tour and Master Ball Research

product_launches.description: Niantic announced the new seasonal content update for Pokémon GO called "Precious Paths," introducing features such as the Kalos Tour events, Master Ball-focused Masterwork Research, new Pokémon debuts, expanded Dynamax battles, and the seasonal GO Pass progression system.

press_references.value: Pokemon Go August 2025 Events: Raid Bosses, Spotlight Hours, Community Day, And More

product_launches.description: Niantic is launching several new features and in-game events for Pokemon Go in August 2025, including the debut of Gigantamax Butterfree, Shadow Kyogre, and Snom, as well as new raid bosses and event mechanics.

press_references.value: Pokemon Go July 2025 Events: Raids, Spotlight Hours, Community Days, And More

product_launches.description: Niantic is launching several new in-game events and features in Pokemon Go during July 2025, including the debut of party hat-wearing Ivysaur and Venusaur, Gimmighoul with a 9th anniversary coin, Hisuian Zorua and Zoroark, and a new Masterwork Research story called Wish Granted.

press_references.value: Pokemon Go Is Adding More Gigantamax Starters During Global Go Fest Events

product_launches.description: Niantic is launching new Gigantamax forms of Rillaboom, Cinderace, and Inteleon in Pokemon Go as part of three global Go Fest events, with each form debuting during a specific event in June 2025.

press_references.value: Finally, a Pokémon Go Update That Players Asked For

product_launches.description: An update that increases Pokémon spawn rates, making the game more accessible to rural players and those with reduced mobility.
